body: Forward test of the flags-judgment context method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.72 (naive base rate 0.85) that: NVIDIA Q4 FY27 revenue is ≥$133.9B (above the top of its $130.0B ±3% guide). Evidence: 8-K 17-Nov-2026 (Q3 FY27): revenue $115.8B (+20% QoQ, +103% YoY) vs Q3 guide $108.0B ±2% (top $110.2B) — beat the top by ~5%. Q4 guide (14-week quarter) $130.0B ±3%, gross margin 71–72% (Q3 74.8%), no China DC compute assumed. Governance flags: 8-K 12-Nov-2026 (Item 5.02) — Board accepted Jen-Hsun Huang's resignation as CEO and director effective 11-Nov-2026; CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; Harvey Jones named Chair; Q3 release references an ongoing independent board-committee investigation and pending Hugging Face acquisition. $150B buyback increase (Sep-2026). Reasoning: Flags-judgment test: does a severe governance shock change near-term delivery when demand and supply are already contracted? We think mostly not, but the range was widened to ±3% (vs ±2%) and margins are guided down, so we shade below NVDA's own beat history. Resolution: YES if NVIDIA's reported Q4 FY27 total revenue (8-K Item 2.02 earnings release) ≥ $133.9B. Source: NVIDIA Q4 FY27 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 1045810). Resolve by 2027-03-10; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: NVIDIA's revenue exceeded the top of its own guidance range in essentially every quarter of the last ~3 years (Q3 FY27 included), ~85–90%.
